blocks.title: Le Chatelier ka usool
blocks.text: Agar equilibrium mein kisi system ko chhera jaye to woh is tarah bartao karta hai ke us chher-chhar ka asar khatam kar de.

Yeh usool bayan karta hai ke jab koi cheez system ko lamhati taur par equilibrium se door le jaye to us ke saath kya hota hai. Henry-Louis Le Chatelier (1850-1936), unniswin sadi ke aakhir aur biswin ke shuru ke French chemist, ne ise pesh kiya, chemistry mein ek aham kamyabi.

blocks.prompt: Le Chatelier ka usool bayan karein aur us se andaza lagayein ke kisi product ka kuch hissa hatane par equilibrium mixture kya karta hai.
blocks.explanation: Chhera hua equilibrium chher-chhar ko radd karne ke liye shift hota hai. Product hatane se us ki concentration girti hai, to system us ka zyada banata hai: equilibrium products ki taraf shift hota hai jab tak naya equilibrium na pohnche.

items: Le Chatelier (1850-1936): chhera hua equilibrium chher-chhar ko khatam karne ke liye shift hota hai.
